VRChat · SPS · OSR

Connect VRChat / SPS and funscripts to OSR and other interactive devices.连接 VRChat / SPS 与 funscript，联动 OSR 等互动设备。

Use VRChat interactions, play a funscript or move a slider. Sensa turns your input into device motion, with the same workbench on desktop and in your browser.

用 VRChat 互动、funscript 脚本或手动滑条驱动设备。Sensa 把输入转换为设备动作，桌面版和网页版沿用同一套工作台操作。

DEVICES AND CONNECTIONS设备与连接

Connect the devices and apps you already use连接你已有的设备与应用

Choose a device, then the connection it supports. Sensa keeps inputs, conversion and output settings in one workbench.

先选设备，再选择它支持的连接；在同一工作台中配置输入、换算与输出。

OSR / SR6 / TCodeOSR / SR6 / TCode

Set axis ranges and direction; connect over serial or the network transports your host supports.

设置轴范围和方向，通过串口或当前宿主支持的网络传输连接。

Intiface / ButtplugIntiface / Buttplug

Discover devices through Intiface and map their advertised position, vibration, rotation or scalar features.

通过 Intiface 发现设备，映射其声明的位置、振动、旋转或标量功能。

Handy · Lovense · Autoblow · VacuGlideHandy · Lovense · Autoblow · VacuGlide

Use the supported device APIs and script controls; available functions depend on the device.

使用已支持的设备 API 与脚本控制，具体功能取决于设备。

DG-LABDG-LAB

Use a dedicated output with its connection and channel settings, alongside your other outputs.

配置专用输出的连接与通道，与其他输出一同使用。

OSC · MIDI CC · HTTP · WebSocket · MQTTOSC · MIDI CC · HTTP · WebSocket · MQTT

Send results to Avatar parameters, MIDI controls, network applications and services. Choose a host with the required connection.

把结果发送到 Avatar 参数、MIDI 控制、网络应用与服务，按连接需求选择宿主。

Funscript · CSV · JSON LinesFunscript · CSV · JSON Lines

Save selected bindings as replayable tracks or detailed diagnostic recordings.

把选定绑定保存为可回放轨道，或记录详细诊断数据。

Find your device and connection →查看设备与连接方式 →

Start with one input and one device先连接一个输入和一台设备

  1. 1

    Open Sensa打开 Sensa

    Download the desktop app for VRChat and the full connection range. Open WebSensa for browser controls and scripts.

    VRChat 联动和完整连接使用桌面版；浏览器控制与脚本可直接打开 WebSensa。

  2. 2

    Add your device添加设备

    Add an output, choose your device and connection, then set its motion range.

    添加输出，选择设备与连接方式，再设置动作范围。

  3. 3

    Choose input, then enable it选择输入，再启用

    Choose OSC, a funscript or Manual. Enable the output and input when ready; emergency stop is always available.

    选择 OSC、funscript 或手动输入。准备好后启用输出与输入，随时可急停。

Desktop or browser: choose the connection you need桌面版还是网页版？按连接需要选择

Both editions use the same workbench and signal engine. Desktop includes the local service; CLI opens that service in your browser.

两种版本沿用同一套工作台和信号引擎。桌面版包含本地服务，CLI 则在浏览器中打开这套服务。

Check WebSensa connections →查看 WebSensa 连接说明 →

Build on the first connection从第一次连接，逐步扩展

Start with one source and one output. Add the tools you need as your setup grows.

先用一个来源连接一个输出，再按需要逐步添加功能。

Shape and combine inputs处理与组合输入

Blend, scale, smooth or gate signals. Add timed effects or spatial calculations, then reuse a named result.

混合、缩放、平滑或门控信号，添加定时效果或空间计算，再复用具名结果。

Calculation examples →查看计算示例 →

Route one result to several outputs一个结果，联动多个输出

Give each binding its own source, conversion, range and sending schedule. Configure several outputs in the same plan.

分别设置每条绑定的来源、换算、范围与发送节奏，在同一方案中配置多个输出。

Outputs and bindings →输出与绑定 →

Share compatible connections共用兼容连接

Several outputs can reuse a compatible physical connection. Desktop tabs share their realtime session; named instances keep independent configurations.

多个输出可共用兼容的实际连接；桌面标签页共用实时会话，命名实例分别保存独立配置。

Connection and routing details →连接与路由说明 →

Record, replay and keep your setup录制、回放，保留完整设置

Record bindings as funscript tracks or diagnostic CSV/JSON Lines. Reuse recordings and save a complete plan with mappings, calculations, profiles and outputs.

把绑定录为 funscript 轨道或诊断 CSV／JSON Lines，复用录制，并保存包含映射、计算、轴配置与输出的整套方案。

Recording and plans →录制与方案 →
